verses.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Ai dos pastores que destroem e dispersam as ovelhas do meu pasto, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on the keepers who are causing the destruction and loss of the sheep of my field, says the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Israel, acerca dos pastores que apascentam o meu povo: Vós dispersastes as minhas ovelhas, e as afugentastes, e não as visitastes. Eis que visitarei sobre vós a maldade das vossas ações, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said against the keepers who have the care of my people: You have let my flock be broken up, driving them away and not caring for them; see, I will send on you the punishment for the evil of your doings, says the Lord.

verses.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.pt: E eu mesmo recolherei o resto das minhas ovelhas de todas as terras para onde as tiver afugentado, e as farei voltar aos seus apriscos; e frutificarão, e se multiplicarão.
verses.en_web: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.
verses.en_bbe: And I will get the rest of my flock together from all the countries where I have sent them, and will make them come back again to their resting-place; and they will have offspring and be increased.

verses.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E levantarei sobre elas pastores que as apascentem, e nunca mais temerão, nem se assombrarão, e nem uma delas faltará, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will set up shepherds over them, who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will put over them keepers who will take care of them: never again will they be overcome with fear or be troubled, and there will not be the loss of one of them, says the Lord.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.pt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que levantarei a Davi um Renovo justo; e, sendo rei, reinará e procederá sabiamente, executando o juízo e a justiça na terra.
verses.en_web: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.en_bbe: See, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will give to David a true Branch, and he will be ruling as king, acting wisely, doing what is right, and judging uprightly in the land.

verses.en: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.pt: Nos seus dias Judá será salvo, e Israel habitará seguro; e este é o nome de que será chamado: O SENHOR JUSTIÇA NOSSA.
verses.en_web: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: In his days Judah will have salvation and Israel will be living without fear: and this is the name by which he will be named, The Lord is our righteousness.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que nunca mais dirão: Vive o Senhor, que tirou os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito;
verses.en_web: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
verses.en_bbe: And so, truly, the days are coming when they will say no longer, By the living Lord, who took the children of Israel up out of the land of Egypt;

verses.en: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.pt: mas: Vive o Senhor, que tirou e que trouxe a linhagem da casa de Israel da terra do norte, e de todas as terras para onde os tinha arrojado; e eles habitarão na sua terra.
verses.en_web: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”
verses.en_bbe: But, By the living Lord, who took up the seed of Israel, and made them come out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had sent them; and they will be living in the land which is theirs.

verses.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.pt: Quanto aos profetas. O meu coração está quebrantado dentro de mim; todos os meus ossos estremecem; sou como um homem embriagado, e como um homem vencido do vinho, por causa do Senhor, e por causa das suas santas palavras.
verses.en_web: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.
verses.en_bbe: About the prophets. My heart is broken in me, all my bones are shaking; I am like a man full of strong drink, like a man overcome by wine; because of the Lord, and because of his holy words.

verses.en: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.pt: Pois a terra está cheia de adúlteros; por causa da maldição a terra chora, e os pastos do deserto se secam. A sua carreira é má, e a sua força não é reta.
verses.en_web: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;
verses.en_bbe: For the land is full of men who are untrue to their wives; because of the curse the land is full of grief; the green fields of the waste land have become dry; and they are quick to do evil, their strength is for what is not right.

verses.en: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Porque tanto o profeta como o sacerdote são profanos; até na minha casa achei a sua maldade, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For the prophet as well as the priest is unclean; even in my house I have seen their evil-doing, says the Lord.

verses.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Portanto o seu caminho lhes será como veredas escorregadias na escuridão; serão empurrados e cairão nele; porque trarei sobre eles mal, o ano mesmo da sua punição, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause their steps will be slipping on their way: they will be forced on into the dark and have a fall there: for I will send evil on them in the year of their punishment, says the Lord.

verses.en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.pt: Nos profetas de Samária bem vi eu insensatez; profetizavam da parte de Baal, e faziam errar o meu povo Israel.
verses.en_web: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.en_bbe: And I have seen ways without sense in the prophets of Samaria; they became prophets of the Baal, causing my people Israel to go wrong.

verses.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.pt: Mas nos profetas de Jerusalém vejo uma coisa horrenda: cometem adultérios, e andam com falsidade, e fortalecem as mãos dos malfeitores, de sorte que não se convertam da sua maldade; eles têm- se tornado para mim como Sodoma, e os moradores dela como Gomorra.
verses.en_web: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a shocking thing; they are untrue to their wives, walking in deceit, and they make strong the hands of evil-doers, so that a man may not be turned back from his evil-doing: they have all become like Sodom to me, and its people like Gomorrah.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos acerca dos profetas: Eis que lhes darei a comer losna, e lhes farei beber águas de fel; porque dos profetas de Jerusalém saiu a contaminação sobre toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”
verses.en_bbe: So this is what the Lord of armies has said about the prophets: See, I will give them a bitter plant for their food, and bitter water for their drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem unclean behaviour has gone out into all the land.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Não deis ouvidos as palavras dos profetas, que vos profetizam a vós, ensinando-vos vaidades; falam da visão do seu coração, não da boca do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Do not give ear to the words which the prophets say to you: they give you teaching of no value: it is from themselves that their vision comes, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.

verses.en: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.pt: Dizem continuamente aos que desprezam a palavra do Senhor: Paz tereis; e a todo o que anda na teimosia do seu coração, dizem: Não virá mal sobre vós.
verses.en_web: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘Yahweh has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’
verses.en_bbe: They keep on saying to those who have no respect for the word of the Lord, You will have peace; and to everyone who goes on his way in the pride of his heart, they say, No evil will come to you.

verses.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.pt: Pois quem dentre eles esteve no concílio do Senhor, para que percebesse e ouvisse a sua palavra, ou quem esteve atento e escutou a sua palavra?
verses.en_web: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?
verses.en_bbe: For which of them has knowledge of the secret of the Lord, and has seen him, and given ear to his word? which of them has taken note of his word and given attention to it?

verses.en: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.pt: Eis a tempestade do Senhor! A sua indignação, qual tempestade devastadora, já saiu; descarregar-se-á sobre a cabeça dos impios.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm: It will burst on the head of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: See, the storm-wind of the Lord, even the heat of his wrath, has gone out, a rolling storm, bursting on the heads of the evil-doers.

verses.en: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.pt: Não retrocederá a ira do Senhor, até que ele tenha executado e cumprido os seus desígnios. Nos últimos dias entendereis isso claramente.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger will not return until he has executed, and until he has performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.
verses.en_bbe: The wrath of the Lord will not be turned back till he has done, till he has put into effect, the purposes of his heart: in days to come you will have full knowledge of this.

verses.en: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.pt: Não mandei esses profetas, contudo eles foram correndo; não lhes falei a eles, todavia eles profetizaram.
verses.en_web: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.en_bbe: I did not send these prophets, but they went running: I said nothing to them, but they gave out the prophet's word.

verses.en: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.pt: Mas se tivessem assistido ao meu concílio, então teriam feito o meu povo ouvir as minhas palavras, e o teriam desviado do seu mau caminho, e da maldade das suas ações.
verses.en_web: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.en_bbe: But if they had been in my secret, then they would have made my people give ear to my words, turning them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

verses.en: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
verses.pt: Sou eu apenas Deus de perto, diz o Senhor, e não também Deus de longe?
verses.en_web: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
verses.en_bbe: Am I only a God who is near, says the Lord, and not a God at a distance?

verses.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Esconder-se-ia alguém em esconderijos, de modo que eu não o veja? diz o Senhor. Porventura não encho eu o céu e a terra? diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: In what secret place may a man take cover without my seeing him? says the Lord. Is there any place in heaven or earth where I am not? says the Lord.

verses.en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.pt: Tenho ouvido o que dizem esses profetas que profetizam mentiras em meu nome, dizendo: Sonhei, sonhei.
verses.en_web: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
verses.en_bbe: My ears have been open to what the prophets have said, who say false words in my name, saying, I have had a dream, I have had a dream, I have had a dream,

verses.en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.pt: Até quando se achará isso no coração dos profetas que profetizam mentiras, e que profetizam do engano do seu próprio coração?
verses.en_web: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
verses.en_bbe: Is (my word) in the hearts of the prophets who give out false words, even the prophets of the deceit of their hearts?

verses.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.pt: Os quais cuidam fazer com que o meu povo se esqueça do meu nome pelos seus sonhos que cada um conta ao seu próximo, assim como seus pais se esqueceram do meu nome por causa de Baal.
verses.en_web: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.
verses.en_bbe: Whose purpose is to take away the memory of my name from my people by their dreams, of which every man is talking to his neighbour, as their fathers gave up the memory of my name for the Baal.

verses.en: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
verses.pt: O profeta que tem um sonho conte o sonho; e aquele que tem a minha palavra, fale fielmente a minha palavra. Que tem a palha com o trigo? diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: If a prophet has a dream, let him give out his dream; and he who has my word, let him give out my word in good faith. What has the dry stem to do with the grain? says the Lord.

verses.en: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.pt: Não é a minha palavra como fogo, diz o Senhor, e como um martelo que esmiúça a pedra?
verses.en_web: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
verses.en_bbe: Is not my word like fire? says the Lord; and like a hammer, smashing the rock to bits?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.pt: Portanto, eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o Senhor, que furtam as minhas palavras, cada um ao seu próximo.
verses.en_web: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I am against the prophets, says the Lord, who take my words, every one from his neighbour.

verses.en: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.pt: Eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o Senhor, que usam de sua própria linguagem, e dizem: Ele disse.
verses.en_web: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’
verses.en_bbe: See, I am against the prophets, says the Lord, who let their tongues say, He has said.

verses.en: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Eis que eu sou contra os que profetizam sonhos mentirosos, diz o Senhor, e os contam, e fazem errar o meu povo com as suas mentiras e com a sua vã jactância; pois eu não os enviei, nem lhes dei ordem; e eles não trazem proveito algum a este povo, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says Yahweh, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am against the prophets of false dreams, says the Lord, who give them out and make my people go out of the way by their deceit and their uncontrolled words: but I did not send them or give them orders; and they will be of no profit to this people, says the Lord.

verses.en: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Quando pois te perguntar este povo, ou um profeta, ou um sacerdote, dizendo: Qual é a profecia do Senhor? Então lhes dirás: Qual a profecia! que eu vos arrojarei, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says Yahweh.’
verses.en_bbe: And if this people, or the prophet, or a priest, questioning you, says, What word of weight is there from the Lord? then you are to say to them, You are the word, for I will not be troubled with you any more, says the Lord.

verses.en: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.pt: E, quanto ao profeta, e ao sacerdote, e ao povo, que disser: A profecia do Senhor; eu castigarei aquele homem e a sua casa.
verses.en_web: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.
verses.en_bbe: And as for the prophet and the priest and the people who say, A word of weight from the Lord! I will send punishment on that man and on his house.

verses.en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.pt: Assim direis, cada um ao seu próximo, e cada um ao seu irmão: Que respondeu o Senhor? e: Que falou o Senhor?
verses.en_web: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has Yahweh answered?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh said?’
verses.en_bbe: But this is what you are to say, every man to his neighbour and every man to his brother, What answer has the Lord given? and, What has the Lord said?

verses.en: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
verses.pt: Mas nunca mais fareis menção da profecia do Senhor, porque a cada um lhe servirá de profecia a sua própria palavra; pois torceis as palavras do Deus vivo, do Senhor dos exércitos, o nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You will mention the message from Yahweh no more: for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies, our God.
verses.en_bbe: And you will no longer put people in mind of the word of weight of the Lord: for every man's word will be a weight on himself; for the words of the living God, of the Lord of armies, our God, have been twisted by you.

verses.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.pt: Assim dirás ao profeta: Que te respondeu o Senhor? e: Que falou o Senhor?
verses.en_web: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’
verses.en_bbe: This is what you are to say to the prophet, What answer has the Lord given to you? and, What has the Lord said?

verses.en: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
verses.pt: Se, porém, disserdes: A profecia do Senhor; assim diz o Senhor: Porque dizeis esta palavra: A profecia do Senhor, quando eu mandei dizer-vos: Não direis: A profecia do Senhor;
verses.en_web: Although you say, ‘The message from Yahweh;’ therefore Yahweh says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from Yahweh,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from Yahweh;”
verses.en_bbe: But if you say, The word of weight of the Lord; this is what the Lord has said: Because you say, The weight of the Lord, and I have sent to you, saying, You are not to say, The weight of the Lord;

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.pt: por isso, eis que certamente eu vos levantarei, e vos lançarei fora da minha presença, a vós e a cidade que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais;
verses.en_web: therefore, behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off, and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, truly, I will put you completely out of my memory, and I will put you, and the town which I gave to you and to your fathers, away from before my face:

verses.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.pt: e porei sobre vós perpétuo opróbrio, e eterna vergonha, que não será esquecida.
verses.en_web: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will give you a name without honour for ever, and unending shame which will never go from the memory of men.
